scenes.title: Yonsei MICS RF Probe Workstation
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. A round silver sample chuck carries a small rectangular substrate and a tiny central device. Two black RF probe heads approach from opposing sides, with thick coaxial lines receding upward. A third rear multi-contact head connects to a flat ribbon cable; clamping screws and dark adjustment hardware surround the chuck.
